title: Mixing: Getting Closer by Wings | 1979
content:
Replica Studio, London
Producers: Paul McCartney, Chris Thomas

The song ‘Getting Closer’ was mixed in stereo for Wings’ seventh studio album Back To The Egg on 15 March 1979.

This day’s mixes remained unused, however, and Paul McCartney recorded new vocals on 19 March.

Part of the session was also spent mixing untitled jams recorded by Wings on 12 March.
